name: ensure-running-workspace
description: Chainable CLI to ensure local services are ready before running commands

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ensure-running/core && npm run build -w @ensure-running/docker && npm run build -w ensure-running
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ensure-running/core && npm run typecheck -w @ensure-running/docker && npm run typecheck -w ensure-running
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run build
